displayName: AI Advisor Lite · AI参谋（四问派活）
description: Delegate tasks to AI like a top expert - ask four questions before every task, then rewrite the task into an expert-grade instruction. Free manual version. Use when assigning real work to AI - proposals, reports, articles, slides, code, contracts, analysis. Trigger words - 派活、派任务、任务改写、四问派活法、提示词优化、task delegation, prompt rewriting, expert briefing, adversarial review.
